Title: Impact of breast milk on cortical pain response in newborns during the heel prick procedure: a randomized controlled trial
Author: Bulut et al.
Comment: The table footnote identifies the displayed ± values as SD through the paper's stated presentation convention and Table 1/Table 3 footnotes. No unit conversion or SD imputation was required. M_diff is stored according to the extraction schema as group_2 minus group_1 (control minus breast milk): 86.16 − 69.38 = 16.78 seconds. For the synthesis-specified orientation of breast milk minus control, the raw MD is −16.78 seconds and favors breast milk. The paper did not explicitly report either mean difference; both are computed from the explicit arm means. No t statistic, degrees of freedom, or confidence interval was reported.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Study Group: 2 mL expressed breast milk orally 2 minutes before heel prick') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Study Environment: Tertiary-care maternity ward/baby room at Istanbul Medeniyet University Goztepe Prof. Dr. Suleyman Yalcın City Hospital
Medium: Oral expressed breast milk administered by syringe
Content length: 2 mL administered 2 minutes before heel prick
Topic of Content: Analgesic effect of expressed breast milk during neonatal heel prick
interaction_type: Clinical painful procedure with nonpharmacological intervention
Participant type: Healthy full-term newborns older than 24 hours
Outcome measurement: Crying time defined as the duration of crying within the five minutes of recording time; assessed from continuous video by two blinded researchers
effect_direction: Breast milk reduced crying duration; intervention-minus-control MD = -16.78 seconds (favours breastfeeding).

Title: Effect analysis of embracing breast milk sucking to relieve pain of neonatal heel blood sampling: a randomized controlled trial.
Author: Wu H, Zhang J, Ding Q, Wang S, Li J
Comment: The paper reports ages 2–29 days, while the synthesis criterion is up to 28 days. Also, although the intervention is called EBMS and the Discussion states that the newborn had access to breast milk, the Methods description explicitly details maternal holding, skin-to-skin contact, comforting, and sampling when quiet but does not clearly state that active sucking or milk administration occurred during the lance. No time-unit conversion or SD imputation was needed; ± was defined as standard deviation in the Statistical analysis section. The synthesis-oriented mean difference is intervention minus control, but it was not entered in M_diff because the extraction schema defines M_diff as group 2 minus group 1 while the paper lists intervention first.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Observation group: EBMS plus routine intervention') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); excluded by outcome classification: does not match the requested outcome/timepoint (meta_analysis_candidate=False)
Design Type: Randomized controlled trial; two-arm parallel-group design
domain: Neonatal procedural pain during heel blood sampling
Topic of Content: Effect of EBMS on neonatal heel-lance procedural pain
interaction_type: Mother–neonate holding/skin-to-skin contact and comforting in the EBMS intervention
Outcome measurement: A stopwatch was used to record neonatal crying time during blood collection; the paper states that values were expressed as mean ± standard deviation.
effect_direction: The observation group had less crying; intervention-minus-control MD = -24.64 seconds (favours the intervention).

Title: Analgesic Effect of Breastfeeding When Taking Blood by Heel-Prick in Newborns
Author: Saitua Iturriaga et al.
Comment: The ± values (42.8 for G1 and 1.26 for G4) are not entered as SDs because the supplied paper text does not explicitly identify them as SD rather than SE/SEM. The paper reports p<0.001, not p=0.001; p_value stores the stated threshold. M_diff was computed as group_2_mean − group_1_mean = 0.19 − 51.7 = −51.51 seconds. This is a historical between-phase comparison: G4 was an observational Phase 2 cohort and G1 was the Phase 1 no-analgesia group, not a concurrent randomized breastfeeding control. The Mann-Whitney test is named, but its test statistic is not reported.; excluded by outcome classification: does not match the requested outcome/timepoint (meta_analysis_candidate=False); d from proportions via OR (p_treatment=0.1900, p_control=0.5170, OR=0.2191); assumes binary outcome
Design Type: Non-blinded observational Phase 2 breastfeeding cohort compared with historical randomized Phase 1 control
Medium: Direct breastfeeding during heel-prick blood collection
interaction_type: Direct breastfeeding during painful procedure versus historical no-analgesia control
Participant type: Healthy term newborns, gestational age 37–42 weeks
Recruitment source: Maternity Unit of Hospital de Basurto
Outcome measurement: Crying time generated by the heel-prick procedure
additional_group_ns: G2: succión+placebo, n=50; G3: succión+sacarosa, n=50
effect_direction: Direct breastfeeding was associated with less crying; breastfeeding-minus-control MD = -51.51 seconds (favours breastfeeding).

Title: Comparative study of responses to pain from venipuncture in healthy term neonates during and after breastfeeding: randomized controlled trial
Author: Boonyaporn Puntitpong
Comment: The reported p-value is an inequality (Group 1 vs Group 3, p<0.001); the numeric p_value field records the stated threshold 0.001, not an exact p-value. Table 7 reports Mean Rank values (24.42, 41.52, 48.06), not raw group mean crying durations, and no arm-level SDs are reported in the Results. Therefore group means, SDs, M_diff, SE_diff, and standardized effects are left null, and this result cannot contribute to the planned raw mean-difference meta-analysis from the available report. Although the Discussion on p. 187 calls these values mean seconds, statistics were restricted to Results and Table 7 explicitly labels them Mean Rank. Group 3 was swaddled, which may conflict with a comparator definition requiring no comfort measure.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Group 1: venipuncture while actively and correctly breastfeeding after at least 2 minutes of breastfeeding') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); unsupported or insufficient statistic type
interaction_type: Mother actively breastfed and held the neonate during venipuncture
Participant type: Healthy term neonates undergoing routine venipuncture at approximately 48 hours of age
Outcome measurement: Cumulative seconds crying from needle insertion until needle withdrawal; throat sounds were excluded and separate crying intervals were summed
additional_group_ns: Group 2 (venipuncture within 10 minutes after completing breastfeeding): n=25; excluded from the planned breastfeeding-during-procedure versus no-intervention comparison
effect_direction: Mean ranks and pairwise testing indicate less crying with breastfeeding (favours breastfeeding).
